readerCopy.body: A refusal becomes harder to dismiss once it has a clear, enforceable boundary around it. When Saturn trines Lilith, structure and autonomy reinforce each other, allowing a repeated objection to become a rule, condition, deadline, contract term, or defined responsibility. Agreement from everyone is not required for the boundary to work. The strength comes from knowing what happens next and making the terms consistent enough that the same conflict does not have to be renegotiated every time.
